selection: First generated turtle, selected by the user on September 8, 2026; original pixels retained.
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production macOS application icon for GitTurtle, a refined native Git client.
Primary request: Create one uniquely beautiful, exceptionally simple app icon: a friendly geometric turtle seen from above, its shell subtly incorporating a Git branch with three connected circular nodes in negative space. It must read clearly at 32 pixels.
Style/medium: precise polished vector-like geometry rendered as a premium raster icon, crisp curves, understated dimensional shading, minimal detail.
Composition/framing: square 1024x1024 canvas; one centered rounded-square dark midnight navy icon tile occupying 88% of canvas, softly rounded macOS-style corners, a generous centered mint jade turtle emblem occupying 65% of tile. Clearly recognizable head and four tiny flippers, smooth solid shell. Transparent canvas outside the tile with restrained soft shadow. Clean balanced silhouette.
Color palette: midnight navy tile (#151D29) and luminous mint jade emblem (#7ADFB4), very subtle teal depth.
Constraints: exactly one icon; no lettering, no words, no border frame, no mockup, no watermark, no extra symbols, no busy circuits, no tortoise scales; do not imitate any existing app logo. The turtle and branch should form one cohesive symbol. Actual transparent background outside the rounded tile.
